title: Grateful Dead Live at Cincinnati Gardens on 1973-12-04
lineage: SBD > Master Reel > DAT > Sony R500 > SEK'D Prodif Plus > Samplitude v7.02 Professional > FLAC16

ai_review.summary: A solid 1973 bonus‑disc capture with clear Jerry tones and standout GDTRFB > Casey Jones and Truckin > Stella Blue jams, though the short first set feels a bit uneven.
ai_review.review: The soundboard source is generally clean – listeners note crisp clarity and a nice, distinct Jerry Garcia guitar tone. Musically the show delivers several highlights (the China Cat > I Know You Rider transition, GDTRFB into Casey Jones and an inspired Truckin > Stella Blue jam), but the performance is brief and occasionally marred by miscues, giving the overall impression of a mixed‑quality concert.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers praise the recording clarity and key song moments, but several note the show’s short length, incomplete set and occasional miscues, leading to a moderate overall score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, crisp sound with nice Jerry tone; no major drop‑outs or muddiness reported.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
Goin' Down the Road Feeling Bad > Casey Jones
show_quality.setlist_flow: Only the first set is present, making the concert unusually short and a bit disjointed; nevertheless the flow contains strong transitions and several high points.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Clear, nice tone highlighted by reviewers.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted for stepping out to address promoter issues during the show.
